mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `ai_usage` (`time`, `chat_type`, `chat_id`, `user_id`, `source`, `count`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`) VALUES (#{time}, #{chatType}, #{chatId}, #{userId}, #{source}, 1, COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `count` = `count` + 1, `input_tokens` = `input_tokens` + COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), `output_tokens` = `output_tokens` + COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0)

INSERT INTO `ai_usage` (`time`, `chat_type`, `chat_id`, `user_id`, `source`, `count`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`) VALUES (#{time}, #{chatType}, #{chatId}, #{userId}, #{source}, 1, COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0)) ON CONFLICT(`time`, `chat_type`, `chat_id`, `user_id`, `source`) DO UPDATE SET `count` = `count` + 1, `input_tokens` = `input_tokens` + COALESCE(#{inputTokens}, 0), `output_tokens` = `output_tokens` + COALESCE(#{outputTokens}, 0)
